title: Pharmacy technician refill authorization and offer-to-counsel relay
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 8.02(6)(c) a pharmacy technician may, with the approval of the pharmacist on duty, request and accept refill authorizations from a prescriber or the prescriber's agent only if no information has changed from the previous prescription. Under 247 CMR 8.02(6)(b) a pharmacy technician may relay the pharmacist's offer to counsel. Under 247 CMR 8.02(6)(d) a pharmacy technician may not administer medications or vaccines, perform drug utilization review, conduct clinical conflict resolution, contact prescribers about therapy clarification or modification, provide patient counseling, or perform final dispensing process validation.
exam_relevance: Tests the unchanged-information condition on technician refill authority and the separation between relaying an offer to counsel and providing counseling.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

exceptions: Refill authority is unavailable when any information has changed from the previous prescription.
common_confusions: A changed quantity, strength or directions takes the refill outside technician authority.
Relaying the offer to counsel is not counseling.
verification_notes: Read in the current official Board of Registration in Pharmacy publication of 247 CMR 8.00 on 2026-08-19 during Batch 3 tranche B3-A authoring under Issue #91. A fresh independent legal and full-bank realism audit is still required before release.
